name: Hominy Bread
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: In a large bowl combine grits, cornmeal, baking powder, salt, butter, and sugar.
In another bowl beat 2 eggs thoroughly, then add milk and mix together completely.
Add egg and milk mixture to dry ingredients.
Grease a large baking dish or 2 loaf pans. Pour mixture into pan(s).
Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes, until golden brown and a knife inserted in the bread comes out clean.
